plain_english.headline: A narrow market, with volatility around normal. Best fit: an inflation shock — commodities and rates up together.
because: A handful of big names are carrying the index — the average stock is falling behind.
Single stocks are moving about as much as the index. The index itself is quiet, with VIX at 16.0, lower than 74% of the past two years.
Option dealers are positioned in a way that amplifies moves — expect bigger swings in both directions than the news deserves.
Trend-following funds are mixed across the 18 markets we track, and none is at an extreme — the positioning is not crowded.
Big speculators are unusually long the dollar, the S&P, gold and 4 others; unusually short natural gas, the Nasdaq and the long bond (CFTC data to 2026-08-11).

1 warning sign lit: the crowd is already positioned this way. A further 12 showed up on individual markets. No single one of these is a reason to sell. They matter when several point the same way as the breadth reading.
plain_english.so_what: Pair it up: short the stretched leader against the average stock. That is the closest fit rather than a clean one — 1 of its conditions are not met. Size at 0.65x your normal risk (cut because the trend is crowded).
watch_for: If the dollar trades above 99.32 (0.6% away), trend funds start buying.
If the 2-year trades above 103.64 (0.6% away), trend funds start buying.
Watch for single stocks becoming more volatile while the index stays calm. That gap is the earliest warning we get.
Watch for the average stock keeping pace with the index again. That ends the leadership trade and starts the breadth trade.
This reading would strengthen if USO flat (roc5 7.61%, roc20 -3.55%) reversed.

levels.if_it_breaks: Below here stocks move together and selection stops paying. Only direction matters in that regime.
Above this, protection is already expensive. A spike through it is not a fresh reason to sell.
Low correlation means stocks trade on their own news and selection pays. Rising back through the middle of its range means everything starts moving together again, and only direction matters.
